name: delab-coding-practices
description: Coding standards for the Erlich lab (delab) plus the two workflows the lab runs them in. The principles skill covers reproducible environments, functional and testable code, cached computation, vectorization, small functions, and keeping secrets and hard-coded paths out of the repo, with before/after examples for Python, Julia, MATLAB and R. Two workflow skills cover pair programming in an IDE and agents orchestrating agents through issues, branches and adversarial review.
